items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I went one time to take lessons with a man by the name of Wickfold... So he said, I don't want your money because I don't need it... So he'd give me up.

ctx.x: Did you take any lessons in the meantime?

No, I never took a lesson in my life. Not a one, huh? Never took a lesson in my life. I went one time to take lessons with a man by the name of Wickfold, who happened to be the trombonist at the Orphan Theater. And he was a very good teacher. So after the first time I went to his house, he told me, he said, son, there's no use of you coming here. He said, I couldn't teach you anything. He said, you're just a fraction of a second behind me all the time. He said, you don't know what the hell you're doing. So he…
You're just picking up everything by ear, huh?
